draft.subject: Your VAT invoice question — and a quick first step
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for your patience on the VAT invoice question — that ticket is still open and Tariq is looking into it, so you'll hear back there. For what it's worth, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and I'm happy to walk through it with you.

On getting started: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how Timber Studio works.

Would a short call this week help? I can stay on while you set up that first project.

Best,
Nadia
